Term | Description

Industry | Level 1 ICB classification
Supersector | Level 2 ICB classification
LP | Indicates if the orderbook has a Liquidity Provider.

LG | Liquidity Group. Ranks the listed shares in three groups, where A is good liquidity and C is weak liquidity. Stocks in the B-group are somewhere in between. Applicable for Stockholm, Helsinki and Copenhagen. Values below is based on the last trading month.
A-Group: Days with Trades = 100%. Average Daily Turnover SEK > 4 MSEK / EUR 400 000 / DKK 4 MDKK. Spread < 1%
C-Group: Days with Trades < 50%. Average Daily Turnover SEK < 200 000 SEK / EUR 20 000 / DKK 200 000 DKK. Spread > 5%
B-Group: Stocks that are not part of the A- or the C-group.
PLUS | Indicates if the instrument is part of the PLUS segment. Only valid in Copenhagen.

NC | Note Code:
BS - Excluding comb. Bonus & Split
OB - On the surveillance list
PO - Company subject to public offer
RS - Reversed Split
SP - Excluding participating in split
SR - Excluding comb. split and issue right/s
SS - Excluding comb. Split & Redemption share
SU - Suspension
UD - Under drawing
WI - When Issued
XD - Excluding dividend
XR - Excluding participating in right/s

Delisted | The date of delisting, if the orderbook have been delisted during the month

Reference Price= Latest Paid

Total Turnover | The total value of shares traded during the period. (Single Counted)
Total No of Traded Shares | The total no of traded shares during the period. (Single Counted)
Total No of Trades | The total no of trades during the period. (Single Counted)

Average Turnover/No of Traded Shares
/No of Trades | The average figure per listed day during the period
Average Trade Size | Total Turnover / Total No of Trades
Traded Days | Number of days with trades / Listed Days
